commits.summary: Close the organic Java PR composition campaign
commits.body:
Both primary public changes consumed all five capabilities at their registered finite scopes, with POI using the frozen ThreeTen implementation. Across seven PRs in six projects all 14 registered claims closed on 35 input histories run on both deployments. The URL-only draw produced an additional alias and partial-failure result before upstream tests were opened. Receiver-identity checks attributed 14 of 360 observed minimum substitutions to the actual public backing arrays across all ten supplementary trials.

The final evidence inventory checks all 41 output hashes from 18 collected jobs, with two earlier diagnostic failures tied to their passed replacements. All 356 claim-receipt references in 70 plans and twelve archives were checked, and sixty missing-premise controls reopened while public values were held fixed. The affected Rust suite, six selected Python tests, seven focused planner controls, test-cost lint and job-schema validation passed. The results include source and binary pins, effort, witnesses, remaining native frontiers and both portable JSON-java production JARs.
